_comment: Explicit test config (baseline mesh, SEED_DIV=200). The buckle base state (mode source) and the HF operating point are intentionally SPLIT - see check_model_consistency.py:66. Buckle disp comes from run_abaqus_buckle.py MODE_PRESTRESS=1e-4; DISP_GLOBAL is deliberately absent so that run_abaqus.py keeps its own operating point (165e-6, run_abaqus.py:234). Adding DISP_GLOBAL here overrides BOTH scripts.
